about_the_game:
Hop on your broom and start a magical adventure! 《Enchanted Broom》 is a 3D platformer filled with magic and exploration. Play as a cute little witch, jump and fly through a vibrant, colorful world, collect scattered magical crystals, and restore the world's balance!

Platforming & Exploration: Use your agile moves to jump and navigate through complex terrain, and discover hidden paths and easter eggs

Broom Flight: Fly freely on your broom, avoid obstacles, or reach areas that are hard to get to with regular jumps

Combat & Puzzles: Throw your spinning broom to fend off enemies, use environmental mechanics to solve puzzles, and unlock new areas

Collection & Progression: Collect crystals to unlock new skills and broom skins, and strengthen your character's abilities

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: AMD R5 5500 或 Intel i3-10100F
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti 或 AMD RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
